items.question: Trong câu "A domain is an easy-to-remember name that represents an IP address on the Internet.", từ "represent" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A domain is an easy-to-remember name that represents an IP address on the Internet.", what does "represent" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: represent /ˌrep.rɪˈzent/ (động từ): đại diện cho, thay cho. Tên miền "represents" (đại diện cho) một địa chỉ IP; cụm hay gặp: "X represents Y".
items.explanationEn: represent /ˌrep.rɪˈzent/ (verb): to stand for something. A domain represents an IP address; the common pattern is "X represents Y".

items.question: Trong câu "Instead of having to remember 142.250.186.46, you just type google.com.", từ "instead of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Instead of having to remember 142.250.186.46, you just type google.com.", what does "instead of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: instead of /ɪnˈsted əv/ (cụm từ): thay vì. "Instead of + V-ing" = thay vì làm gì; ở đây là thay vì phải nhớ dãy số IP.
items.explanationEn: instead of /ɪnˈsted əv/ (phrase): in the place of. "Instead of + -ing" means rather than doing something; here, rather than memorising an IP.

items.question: Trong câu "A domain is a digital asset — you must register it and pay an annual fee to own it.", từ "asset" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A domain is a digital asset — you must register it and pay an annual fee to own it.", what does "asset" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: asset /ˈæs.et/ (danh từ): tài sản. "Digital asset" = tài sản số; tên miền là thứ có giá trị bạn sở hữu.
items.explanationEn: asset /ˈæs.et/ (noun): something valuable you own. "Digital asset" is a valuable thing that exists online, such as a domain.

items.question: Trong câu "A domain is a digital asset — you must register it and pay an annual fee to own it.", từ "digital" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A domain is a digital asset — you must register it and pay an annual fee to own it.", what does "digital" (adjective) mean?
options: thuộc về số, trên môi trường số
items.explanation: digital /ˈdɪdʒ.ɪ.təl/ (tính từ): thuộc về số, trên môi trường số. "Digital" nghĩa gốc liên quan đến ngón tay (digit), nhưng trong IT là "số, điện tử": digital asset, digital product.
items.explanationEn: digital /ˈdɪdʒ.ɪ.təl/ (adjective): existing in electronic form. "Digital" originally relates to digits (fingers), but in IT it means electronic: digital asset, digital product.

items.question: Trong câu "A domain is a digital asset — you must register it and pay an annual fee to own it.", từ "register" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A domain is a digital asset — you must register it and pay an annual fee to own it.", what does "register" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to put your name on an official list
items.explanation: register /ˈredʒ.ɪ.stər/ (động từ): đăng ký. "Register a domain" = đăng ký tên miền; danh từ liên quan: registration, registrar.
items.explanationEn: register /ˈredʒ.ɪ.stər/ (verb): to put your name on an official list. "Register a domain" means officially recording it in your name; related: registration, registrar.

items.question: Trong câu "A domain is a digital asset — you must register it and pay an annual fee to own it.", từ "annual" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A domain is a digital asset — you must register it and pay an annual fee to own it.", what does "annual" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: annual /ˈæn.ju.əl/ (tính từ): hằng năm. "Annual fee" = phí thường niên; tương tự: annual report (báo cáo năm).
items.explanationEn: annual /ˈæn.ju.əl/ (adjective): happening once a year. "Annual fee" is a fee paid every year; similarly, annual report.

items.question: Trong câu "A domain is a digital asset — you must register it and pay an annual fee to own it.", từ "fee" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A domain is a digital asset — you must register it and pay an annual fee to own it.", what does "fee" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: fee /fiː/ (danh từ): lệ phí, khoản phí. "Pay a fee" = trả phí; hay gặp: registration fee, annual fee.
items.explanationEn: fee /fiː/ (noun): money paid for a service. "Pay a fee" is the usual collocation; also registration fee, annual fee.

items.question: Trong câu "A self-created prefix used to divide up services:", từ "prefix" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A self-created prefix used to divide up services:", what does "prefix" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a part added at the end
a shortened form of a word
a part added at the front
items.explanation: prefix /ˈpriː.fɪks/ (danh từ): tiền tố, phần đứng trước. Subdomain là "prefix" đứng trước tên miền chính (www., mail.); trái nghĩa: suffix.
items.explanationEn: prefix /ˈpriː.fɪks/ (noun): a part added at the front. A subdomain is a prefix placed before the main domain (www., mail.); the opposite is suffix.

items.question: Trong câu "A self-created prefix used to divide up services:", từ "divide up" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A self-created prefix used to divide up services:", what does "divide up" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: divide up /dɪˈvaɪd ʌp/ (cụm từ): chia ra, phân chia. "Divide up X" = chia X thành nhiều phần; ở đây subdomain dùng để tách các dịch vụ.
items.explanationEn: divide up /dɪˈvaɪd ʌp/ (phrase): to separate into parts. "Divide up X" means split X into parts; here subdomains separate the services.

items.question: Trong câu "dev.example.com — the development environment.", từ "environment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "dev.example.com — the development environment.", what does "environment" (noun) mean?
options: môi trường (hệ thống chạy phần mềm)
items.explanation: environment /ɪnˈvaɪ.rən.mənt/ (danh từ): môi trường (hệ thống chạy phần mềm). Trong IT, "environment" là môi trường chạy: development, staging, production environment.
items.explanationEn: environment /ɪnˈvaɪ.rən.mənt/ (noun): a setup where software runs. In IT, an environment is where software runs: development, staging, production environment.

items.question: Trong câu "These three concepts are often confused — but they have a containment relationship:", từ "concept" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These three concepts are often confused — but they have a containment relationship:", what does "concept" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: concept /ˈkɒn.sept/ (danh từ): khái niệm. "Concept" = khái niệm, ý tưởng chung; "the broadest concept" = khái niệm rộng nhất.
items.explanationEn: concept /ˈkɒn.sept/ (noun): a general idea. "Concept" is an abstract idea; "the broadest concept" is the most general one.

items.question: Trong câu "These three concepts are often confused — but they have a containment relationship:", từ "confused" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These three concepts are often confused — but they have a containment relationship:", what does "confused" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: confused /kənˈfjuːzd/ (tính từ): bị nhầm lẫn với nhau. "Be often confused" = hay bị nhầm lẫn; "confuse A with B" = nhầm A với B.
items.explanationEn: confused /kənˈfjuːzd/ (adjective): mistaken for one another. "Be often confused" means people mix them up; "confuse A with B" means mistake A for B.

items.question: Trong câu "These three concepts are often confused — but they have a containment relationship:", từ "containment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These three concepts are often confused — but they have a containment relationship:", what does "containment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: containment /kənˈteɪn.mənt/ (danh từ): sự bao hàm, chứa đựng. "Containment relationship" = quan hệ bao hàm (URL nằm trong URI); nghĩa khác: sự ngăn chặn (dịch bệnh).
items.explanationEn: containment /kənˈteɪn.mənt/ (noun): the state of being inside. "Containment relationship" means one set sits inside another (URL within URI); another sense is stopping a spread.

items.question: Trong câu "URI (Uniform Resource Identifier) — a string that identifies any resource.", từ "identify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "URI (Uniform Resource Identifier) — a string that identifies any resource.", what does "identify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: identify /aɪˈden.tɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): xác định, nhận diện. "Identify a resource" = xác định một tài nguyên; danh từ: identifier (định danh), identity.
items.explanationEn: identify /aɪˈden.tɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to show exactly which one. "Identify a resource" means pointing out exactly which one; nouns: identifier, identity.

items.question: Trong câu "URI (Uniform Resource Identifier) — a string that identifies any resource.", từ "resource" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "URI (Uniform Resource Identifier) — a string that identifies any resource.", what does "resource" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an item you can fetch online
items.explanation: resource /rɪˈzɔːs/ (danh từ): tài nguyên (trên web). Trên web, "resource" là thứ có địa chỉ: trang, ảnh, file; nghĩa khác: nguồn lực (tiền, người).
items.explanationEn: resource /rɪˈzɔːs/ (noun): an item you can fetch online. On the web, a resource is anything with an address: a page, image or file; another sense is supplies like money or staff.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the broadest concept.", từ "broad" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the broadest concept.", what does "broad" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: broad /brɔːd/ (tính từ): rộng, bao quát. "Broad" = rộng; "the broadest concept" = khái niệm bao quát nhất; trái nghĩa: narrow.
items.explanationEn: broad /brɔːd/ (adjective): covering many things. "The broadest concept" is the most general one; the opposite of broad is narrow.

items.question: Trong câu "URL (Uniform Resource Locator) — a type of URI that tells you where the resource is and how to access it (the protocol).", từ "access" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "URL (Uniform Resource Locator) — a type of URI that tells you where the resource is and how to access it (the protocol).", what does "access" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: access /ˈæk.ses/ (động từ): truy cập. "Access a resource/website" = truy cập tài nguyên; đừng nhầm với "assess" (đánh giá).
items.explanationEn: access /ˈæk.ses/ (verb): to reach and use. "Access a resource" means reach and use it; do not confuse it with "assess" (evaluate).

items.question: Trong câu "URL (Uniform Resource Locator) — a type of URI that tells you where the resource is and how to access it (the protocol).", từ "protocol" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "URL (Uniform Resource Locator) — a type of URI that tells you where the resource is and how to access it (the protocol).", what does "protocol" (noun) mean?
options: giao thức (quy tắc truyền dữ liệu)
optionsEn: a set of rules for communication
items.explanation: protocol /ˈprəʊ.tə.kɒl/ (danh từ): giao thức (quy tắc truyền dữ liệu). Trong mạng, "protocol" là giao thức như HTTP, HTTPS; nghĩa khác: nghi thức ngoại giao.
items.explanationEn: protocol /ˈprəʊ.tə.kɒl/ (noun): a set of rules for communication. In networking, a protocol is a rule set such as HTTP or HTTPS; another sense is diplomatic etiquette.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the type you encounter every day.", từ "encounter" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the type you encounter every day.", what does "encounter" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: encounter /ɪnˈkaʊn.tər/ (động từ): gặp phải, bắt gặp. "Encounter" = bắt gặp, thường gặp; hay dùng: encounter an error (gặp lỗi).
items.explanationEn: encounter /ɪnˈkaʊn.tər/ (verb): to come across. "Encounter" means come across; a common collocation is "encounter an error".

items.question: Trong câu "Rule of thumb: Every URL is a URI, but not every URI is a URL.", từ "rule of thumb" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rule of thumb: Every URL is a URI, but not every URI is a URL.", what does "rule of thumb" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rule of thumb /ˌruːl əv ˈθʌm/ (cụm từ): quy tắc kinh nghiệm. "Rule of thumb" = quy tắc dựa trên kinh nghiệm, dễ nhớ, không tuyệt đối chính xác.
items.explanationEn: rule of thumb /ˌruːl əv ˈθʌm/ (phrase): a practical guideline. "Rule of thumb" is an easy practical guideline, not a strict rule.

items.question: Trong câu "The service port — 80 for http, 443 for https; can be omitted if default", từ "omit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The service port — 80 for http, 443 for https; can be omitted if default", what does "omit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: omit /əˈmɪt/ (động từ): bỏ qua, lược bớt. "Can be omitted" = có thể lược bỏ; port mặc định không cần ghi trong URL.
items.explanationEn: omit /əˈmɪt/ (verb): to leave out. "Can be omitted" means it may be left out; the default port need not be written.

items.question: Trong câu "The service port — 80 for http, 443 for https; can be omitted if default", từ "default" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The service port — 80 for http, 443 for https; can be omitted if default", what does "default" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: default /dɪˈfɔːlt/ (danh từ): giá trị mặc định. "If default" = nếu là mặc định; "by default" = theo mặc định; nghĩa khác trong tài chính: vỡ nợ.
items.explanationEn: default /dɪˈfɔːlt/ (noun): the preset standard value. "By default" means automatically unless changed; in finance, default means failing to repay.

items.question: Trong câu "An anchor #section — points to a location within the page, not sent to the server", từ "anchor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An anchor #section — points to a location within the page, not sent to the server", what does "anchor" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a marked spot in a page
items.explanation: anchor /ˈæŋ.kər/ (danh từ): điểm neo (vị trí trong trang). Trong URL, "anchor" (#section) trỏ tới một vị trí trong trang; nghĩa gốc: mỏ neo tàu.
items.explanationEn: anchor /ˈæŋ.kər/ (noun): a marked spot in a page. In a URL, an anchor (#section) points to a spot in the page; its literal sense is a ship's anchor.

items.question: Trong câu "It describes the specific resource you want to access.", từ "specific" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It describes the specific resource you want to access.", what does "specific" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: specific /spəˈsɪf.ɪk/ (tính từ): cụ thể, riêng biệt. "The specific resource" = tài nguyên cụ thể; trái nghĩa: general.
items.explanationEn: specific /spəˈsɪf.ɪk/ (adjective): particular, exact. "The specific resource" is one particular resource; the opposite is general.

items.question: Trong câu "A path mimics a directory structure:", từ "mimic" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A path mimics a directory structure:", what does "mimic" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: mimic /ˈmɪm.ɪk/ (động từ): bắt chước, mô phỏng. "Mimic" = bắt chước; path mô phỏng cấu trúc thư mục (folder) trong máy tính.
items.explanationEn: mimic /ˈmɪm.ɪk/ (verb): to copy the form of. "Mimic" means imitate; a path copies the shape of folders on a computer.

items.question: Trong câu "A path mimics a directory structure:", từ "directory" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A path mimics a directory structure:", what does "directory" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: directory /daɪˈrek.tər.i/ (danh từ): thư mục (trên máy tính). Trong máy tính, "directory" = thư mục; nghĩa khác: danh bạ (phone directory).
items.explanationEn: directory /daɪˈrek.tər.i/ (noun): a folder for files. In computing, a directory is a folder; another sense is a listing such as a phone directory.

items.question: Trong câu "The "parent–child" relationship in the path forms the information architecture of the website.", từ "architecture" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The "parent–child" relationship in the path forms the information architecture of the website.", what does "architecture" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: architecture /ˈɑː.kɪ.tek.tʃər/ (danh từ): cách tổ chức cấu trúc. "Information architecture" = kiến trúc thông tin, cách sắp xếp nội dung website; nghĩa gốc: kiến trúc nhà.
items.explanationEn: architecture /ˈɑː.kɪ.tek.tʃər/ (noun): the way parts are organised. "Information architecture" is how a site's content is organised; the literal sense is building design.

items.question: Trong câu "Locates a unique resource", từ "locate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Locates a unique resource", what does "locate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: locate /ləʊˈkeɪt/ (động từ): xác định vị trí. "Locate" = tìm/xác định vị trí; "be located at" = nằm ở.
items.explanationEn: locate /ləʊˈkeɪt/ (verb): to find where something is. "Locate" means find the position; "be located at" means be situated at.

items.question: Trong câu "Locates a unique resource", từ "unique" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Locates a unique resource", what does "unique" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: the only one of its kind
items.explanation: unique /juːˈniːk/ (tính từ): duy nhất, không trùng. "Unique" = duy nhất; mỗi path trỏ tới một tài nguyên không trùng với cái khác.
items.explanationEn: unique /juːˈniːk/ (adjective): the only one of its kind. "Unique" means one of a kind; each path points to one distinct resource.

items.question: Trong câu "A sitemap is a list of all the important URLs of a website, helping search engines (Google, Bing) discover and index content faster.", từ "discover" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A sitemap is a list of all the important URLs of a website, helping search engines (Google, Bing) discover and index content faster.", what does "discover" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to find for the first time
items.explanation: discover /dɪˈskʌv.ər/ (động từ): tìm ra, phát hiện. "Discover content" = tìm ra nội dung mới; danh từ: discovery.
items.explanationEn: discover /dɪˈskʌv.ər/ (verb): to find for the first time. "Discover content" means find it for the first time; noun: discovery.

items.question: Trong câu "Dynamic param: /users/123 — 123 is the user id, and the server returns different data accordingly.", từ "accordingly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dynamic param: /users/123 — 123 is the user id, and the server returns different data accordingly.", what does "accordingly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: accordingly /əˈkɔː.dɪŋ.li/ (trạng từ): tương ứng, cho phù hợp. "Accordingly" = theo đó, tương ứng; server trả dữ liệu khác nhau tùy theo id.
items.explanationEn: accordingly /əˈkɔː.dɪŋ.li/ (adverb): in a matching way. "Accordingly" means in a way that fits; the server returns data matching the id.

items.question: Trong câu "Nested: /shop/category/laptop/asus — reflects the category hierarchy.", từ "reflect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Nested: /shop/category/laptop/asus — reflects the category hierarchy.", what does "reflect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reflect /rɪˈflekt/ (động từ): thể hiện, phản ánh. "Reflect X" = phản ánh X; nghĩa khác: phản chiếu (gương), suy ngẫm (reflect on).
items.explanationEn: reflect /rɪˈflekt/ (verb): to show or express. "Reflect X" means show X; other senses: mirror light, or think carefully (reflect on).

items.question: Trong câu "Nested: /shop/category/laptop/asus — reflects the category hierarchy.", từ "hierarchy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Nested: /shop/category/laptop/asus — reflects the category hierarchy.", what does "hierarchy" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: hierarchy /ˈhaɪə.rɑː.ki/ (danh từ): hệ thống phân cấp. "Hierarchy" = cấp bậc, phân tầng cha–con; tính từ: hierarchical.
items.explanationEn: hierarchy /ˈhaɪə.rɑː.ki/ (noun): a ranked system of levels. "Hierarchy" is a parent–child ranking of levels; adjective: hierarchical.

items.question: Trong câu "/blog/ and /blog can technically be two different URLs.", từ "technically" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "/blog/ and /blog can technically be two different URLs.", what does "technically" (adverb) mean?
options: về mặt kỹ thuật, xét theo quy tắc
items.explanation: technically /ˈtek.nɪ.kəl.i/ (trạng từ): về mặt kỹ thuật, xét theo quy tắc. "Technically" = xét chặt chẽ theo quy tắc, dù thực tế người dùng thấy như nhau.
items.explanationEn: technically /ˈtek.nɪ.kəl.i/ (adverb): strictly by the rules. "Technically" means strictly speaking, even if users see no difference in practice.

items.question: Trong câu "Most websites pick one standard and 301-redirect the other to avoid duplicate content.", từ "avoid" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Most websites pick one standard and 301-redirect the other to avoid duplicate content.", what does "avoid" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: avoid /əˈvɔɪd/ (động từ): tránh. "Avoid + N/V-ing" = tránh điều gì; ví dụ: avoid duplicate content, avoid using.
items.explanationEn: avoid /əˈvɔɪd/ (verb): to prevent from happening. "Avoid + noun/-ing" means keep something from happening, e.g. avoid duplicate content.

items.question: Trong câu "Most websites pick one standard and 301-redirect the other to avoid duplicate content.", từ "duplicate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Most websites pick one standard and 301-redirect the other to avoid duplicate content.", what does "duplicate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: duplicate /ˈdjuː.plɪ.kət/ (tính từ): trùng lặp. "Duplicate content" = nội dung trùng lặp ở nhiều URL; động từ: duplicate (sao chép).
items.explanationEn: duplicate /ˈdjuː.plɪ.kət/ (adjective): exactly the same as another. "Duplicate content" is the same content at several URLs; as a verb, duplicate means copy.

items.question: Trong câu "Large websites have thousands of URLs — bots cannot crawl them all on their own.", từ "crawl" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Large websites have thousands of URLs — bots cannot crawl them all on their own.", what does "crawl" (verb) mean?
options: thu thập dữ liệu (quét trang web)
optionsEn: to move on hands and knees
items.explanation: crawl /krɔːl/ (động từ): thu thập dữ liệu (quét trang web). Bot "crawl" website = lần theo liên kết để quét các trang; nghĩa gốc: bò, trườn.
items.explanationEn: crawl /krɔːl/ (verb): to visit pages automatically. Bots crawl a site by following links to scan pages; the literal sense is to move on hands and knees.

items.question: Trong câu "Large websites have thousands of URLs — bots cannot crawl them all on their own.", từ "on their own" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Large websites have thousands of URLs — bots cannot crawl them all on their own.", what does "on their own" (phrase) mean?
options: tự mình, không cần trợ giúp
items.explanation: on their own /ɒn ðeər ˈəʊn/ (cụm từ): tự mình, không cần trợ giúp. "On one's own" = tự làm, không có trợ giúp; ở đây bot cần sitemap hỗ trợ.
items.explanationEn: on their own /ɒn ðeər ˈəʊn/ (phrase): without help. "On one's own" means without help; here bots need a sitemap to assist them.

items.question: Trong câu "New pages or pages with few internal links → bots have trouble finding them.", từ "internal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "New pages or pages with few internal links → bots have trouble finding them.", what does "internal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: internal /ɪnˈtɜː.nəl/ (tính từ): nội bộ, bên trong. "Internal links" = liên kết nội bộ giữa các trang trong cùng website; trái nghĩa: external.
items.explanationEn: internal /ɪnˈtɜː.nəl/ (adjective): inside the same site. "Internal links" connect pages within one site; the opposite is external.

items.question: Trong câu "The sitemap tells the bot clearly: "Here are all the pages I want indexed, their priorities, and when they were last modified."", từ "priority" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The sitemap tells the bot clearly: "Here are all the pages I want indexed, their priorities, and when they were last modified."", what does "priority" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: priority /praɪˈɒr.ə.ti/ (danh từ): mức độ ưu tiên. "Priority" = độ ưu tiên; "high priority" = ưu tiên cao; động từ: prioritize.
items.explanationEn: priority /praɪˈɒr.ə.ti/ (noun): the level of importance. "Priority" is how important something is; "high priority"; verb: prioritize.

items.question: Trong câu "The sitemap tells the bot clearly: "Here are all the pages I want indexed, their priorities, and when they were last modified."", từ "modify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The sitemap tells the bot clearly: "Here are all the pages I want indexed, their priorities, and when they were last modified."", what does "modify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: modify /ˈmɒd.ɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): sửa đổi, chỉnh sửa. "Last modified" = lần sửa đổi gần nhất; danh từ: modification.
items.explanationEn: modify /ˈmɒd.ɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to change slightly. "Last modified" means the most recent change; noun: modification.

items.question: Trong câu "Large sites split it into several smaller sitemaps and gather them into a sitemap index:", từ "split" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Large sites split it into several smaller sitemaps and gather them into a sitemap index:", what does "split" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: split /splɪt/ (động từ): chia tách. "Split X into Y" = chia X thành Y; trái nghĩa: merge, combine.
items.explanationEn: split /splɪt/ (verb): to divide into parts. "Split X into Y" means divide X into Y; the opposite is merge.

items.question: Trong câu "Large sites split it into several smaller sitemaps and gather them into a sitemap index:", từ "gather" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Large sites split it into several smaller sitemaps and gather them into a sitemap index:", what does "gather" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: gather /ˈɡæð.ər/ (động từ): gom lại, tập hợp. "Gather them into" = gom chúng vào một chỗ; hay dùng: gather data, gather requirements.
items.explanationEn: gather /ˈɡæð.ər/ (verb): to collect together. "Gather them into" means bring them together; also gather data, gather requirements.

items.question: Trong câu "A sitemap is essentially a list of valid URLs, where each URL = scheme + host + path.", từ "essentially" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A sitemap is essentially a list of valid URLs, where each URL = scheme + host + path.", what does "essentially" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: essentially /ɪˈsen.ʃəl.i/ (trạng từ): về bản chất. "Essentially" = xét về bản chất, nói gọn lại; đồng nghĩa: basically.
items.explanationEn: essentially /ɪˈsen.ʃəl.i/ (adverb): basically, at its core. "Essentially" means at its core; a synonym is basically.

items.question: Trong câu "A sitemap is essentially a list of valid URLs, where each URL = scheme + host + path.", từ "valid" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A sitemap is essentially a list of valid URLs, where each URL = scheme + host + path.", what does "valid" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: valid /ˈvæl.ɪd/ (tính từ): hợp lệ. "Valid URL" = URL hợp lệ, hoạt động được; trái nghĩa: invalid.
items.explanationEn: valid /ˈvæl.ɪd/ (adjective): correct and acceptable. "Valid URL" is one that is correct and works; the opposite is invalid.

items.question: Trong câu "A messy, long path with many parameters → a sitemap that is hard to maintain, with weak SEO.", từ "maintain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A messy, long path with many parameters → a sitemap that is hard to maintain, with weak SEO.", what does "maintain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: maintain /meɪnˈteɪn/ (động từ): duy trì, bảo trì. "Hard to maintain" = khó bảo trì; nghĩa khác: khẳng định (maintain that...).
items.explanationEn: maintain /meɪnˈteɪn/ (verb): to keep in good condition. "Hard to maintain" means difficult to keep in order; another sense is to claim (maintain that...).

items.question: Trong câu "A messy, long path with many parameters → a sitemap that is hard to maintain, with weak SEO.", từ "messy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A messy, long path with many parameters → a sitemap that is hard to maintain, with weak SEO.", what does "messy" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: messy /ˈmes.i/ (tính từ): lộn xộn. "Messy path" = đường dẫn lộn xộn, khó đọc; trái nghĩa: clean, tidy.
items.explanationEn: messy /ˈmes.i/ (adjective): untidy and disorganised. "Messy path" is a disorganised, hard-to-read path; the opposite is clean.

items.question: Trong câu "The robots.txt file at the site root usually declares the sitemap's location:", từ "declare" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The robots.txt file at the site root usually declares the sitemap's location:", what does "declare" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: declare /dɪˈkleər/ (động từ): khai báo. "Declare" = khai báo; trong lập trình cũng dùng: declare a variable (khai báo biến).
items.explanationEn: declare /dɪˈkleər/ (verb): to state officially. "Declare" means state formally; in programming, you declare a variable.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the official way to tell bots where the sitemap is.", từ "official" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the official way to tell bots where the sitemap is.", what does "official" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: official /əˈfɪʃ.əl/ (tính từ): chính thức. "The official way" = cách chính thức, được công nhận; danh từ khác nghĩa: an official (viên chức).
items.explanationEn: official /əˈfɪʃ.əl/ (adjective): formally approved. "The official way" is the formally recognised method; as a noun, an official is a person in authority.

items.question: Trong câu "DNS (Domain Name System) is a global hierarchical system for resolving domains into IPs.", từ "global" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DNS (Domain Name System) is a global hierarchical system for resolving domains into IPs.", what does "global" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: global /ˈɡləʊ.bəl/ (tính từ): toàn cầu. "Global system" = hệ thống toàn cầu; trạng từ: globally; trái nghĩa: local.
items.explanationEn: global /ˈɡləʊ.bəl/ (adjective): covering the whole world. "Global system" works worldwide; adverb: globally; opposite: local.

items.question: Trong câu "DNS (Domain Name System) is a global hierarchical system for resolving domains into IPs.", từ "hierarchical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DNS (Domain Name System) is a global hierarchical system for resolving domains into IPs.", what does "hierarchical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: hierarchical /ˌhaɪəˈrɑː.kɪ.kəl/ (tính từ): phân cấp. DNS "hierarchical" = phân tầng: root → TLD → authoritative; danh từ: hierarchy.
items.explanationEn: hierarchical /ˌhaɪəˈrɑː.kɪ.kəl/ (adjective): arranged in levels. DNS is hierarchical: root → TLD → authoritative; noun: hierarchy.

items.question: Trong câu "DNS (Domain Name System) is a global hierarchical system for resolving domains into IPs.", từ "resolve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DNS (Domain Name System) is a global hierarchical system for resolving domains into IPs.", what does "resolve" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to convert a name to an address
items.explanation: resolve /rɪˈzɒlv/ (động từ): phân giải (tên thành địa chỉ). "Resolve A into B" = phân giải A thành B; nghĩa khác: giải quyết (resolve an issue).
items.explanationEn: resolve /rɪˈzɒlv/ (verb): to convert a name to an address. "Resolve A into B" means translate A to B; another sense is to fix (resolve an issue).

items.question: Trong câu "Every DNS record has a TTL — the time (in seconds) the result is cached.", từ "record" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every DNS record has a TTL — the time (in seconds) the result is cached.", what does "record" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: record /ˈrek.ɔːd/ (danh từ): bản ghi (dữ liệu). "DNS record" = bản ghi DNS (A, CNAME, MX...); nghĩa khác: kỷ lục (break a record).
items.explanationEn: record /ˈrek.ɔːd/ (noun): a stored entry of data. A DNS record is one stored entry (A, CNAME, MX...); another sense is a best-ever result.

items.question: Trong câu "Every DNS record has a TTL — the time (in seconds) the result is cached.", từ "cache" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every DNS record has a TTL — the time (in seconds) the result is cached.", what does "cache" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: cache /kæʃ/ (động từ): lưu tạm để dùng lại. "Be cached" = được lưu tạm; phát âm giống "cash" /kæʃ/.
items.explanationEn: cache /kæʃ/ (verb): to store for quick reuse. "Be cached" means kept temporarily for fast reuse; it is pronounced like "cash".

items.question: Trong câu "Low TTL: DNS changes take effect quickly (within minutes) but consume more server resources.", từ "take effect" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Low TTL: DNS changes take effect quickly (within minutes) but consume more server resources.", what does "take effect" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: take effect /teɪk ɪˈfekt/ (cụm từ): có hiệu lực. "Take effect" = bắt đầu có hiệu lực; ví dụ: the change takes effect immediately.
items.explanationEn: take effect /teɪk ɪˈfekt/ (phrase): to start to apply. "Take effect" means begin to work; e.g. the change takes effect immediately.

items.question: Trong câu "Low TTL: DNS changes take effect quickly (within minutes) but consume more server resources.", từ "consume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Low TTL: DNS changes take effect quickly (within minutes) but consume more server resources.", what does "consume" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: consume /kənˈsjuːm/ (động từ): tiêu tốn. "Consume resources" = tiêu tốn tài nguyên; nghĩa khác: ăn, uống; danh từ: consumption.
items.explanationEn: consume /kənˈsjuːm/ (verb): to use up. "Consume resources" means use them up; another sense is eat or drink; noun: consumption.

items.question: Trong câu "High TTL: saves resources but changes take longer to propagate.", từ "propagate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "High TTL: saves resources but changes take longer to propagate.", what does "propagate" (verb) mean?
options: lan truyền, cập nhật rộng khắp
items.explanation: propagate /ˈprɒp.ə.ɡeɪt/ (động từ): lan truyền, cập nhật rộng khắp. DNS "propagate" = thay đổi lan dần tới mọi máy chủ DNS; nghĩa khác: nhân giống cây.
items.explanationEn: propagate /ˈprɒp.ə.ɡeɪt/ (verb): to spread widely. DNS changes propagate by gradually reaching all DNS servers; another sense is to breed plants.

items.question: Trong câu "Practical note: When switching hosting, DNS changes can take 24–48 hours to "propagate" globally because of the old TTL.", từ "practical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Practical note: When switching hosting, DNS changes can take 24–48 hours to "propagate" globally because of the old TTL.", what does "practical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: practical /ˈpræk.tɪ.kəl/ (tính từ): thực tế, thực tiễn. "Practical note" = lưu ý thực tế; trái nghĩa: theoretical.
items.explanationEn: practical /ˈpræk.tɪ.kəl/ (adjective): related to real use. "Practical note" is advice from real use; the opposite is theoretical.

items.question: Trong câu "Practical note: When switching hosting, DNS changes can take 24–48 hours to "propagate" globally because of the old TTL.", từ "switch" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Practical note: When switching hosting, DNS changes can take 24–48 hours to "propagate" globally because of the old TTL.", what does "switch" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: switch /swɪtʃ/ (động từ): chuyển đổi (sang cái khác). "Switch hosting" = chuyển sang nhà cung cấp hosting khác; "switch to X" = chuyển sang X.
items.explanationEn: switch /swɪtʃ/ (verb): to change to another. "Switch hosting" means move to another host; "switch to X" means change to X.

items.question: Trong câu "Practical note: When switching hosting, DNS changes can take 24–48 hours to "propagate" globally because of the old TTL.", từ "globally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Practical note: When switching hosting, DNS changes can take 24–48 hours to "propagate" globally because of the old TTL.", what does "globally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: globally /ˈɡləʊ.bəl.i/ (trạng từ): trên toàn cầu. "Propagate globally" = lan ra toàn cầu; tính từ: global.
items.explanationEn: globally /ˈɡləʊ.bəl.i/ (adverb): all over the world. "Propagate globally" means spread worldwide; adjective: global.

items.question: Trong câu "You register a domain through a Registrar:", từ "register" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You register a domain through a Registrar:", what does "register" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: register /ˈredʒ.ɪ.stər/ (động từ): đăng ký (chính thức). "Register a domain" = đăng ký tên miền; nghĩa khác: gửi thư bảo đảm (registered mail).
items.explanationEn: register /ˈredʒ.ɪ.stər/ (verb): to record officially. "Register a domain" means record it officially; "registered mail" is a different sense.

items.question: Trong câu "You register a domain through a Registrar:", từ "registrar" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You register a domain through a Registrar:", what does "registrar" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: registrar /ˌredʒ.ɪˈstrɑːr/ (danh từ): nhà đăng ký tên miền. "Registrar" = đơn vị được cấp phép bán/đăng ký tên miền; nghĩa khác: phòng đào tạo (đại học).
items.explanationEn: registrar /ˌredʒ.ɪˈstrɑːr/ (noun): a company that registers domains. A registrar is an accredited seller of domains; in universities, it is also the records office.

items.question: Trong câu "International: GoDaddy, Namecheap, Google Domains, Cloudflare.", từ "international" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "International: GoDaddy, Namecheap, Google Domains, Cloudflare.", what does "international" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: international /ˌɪn.təˈnæʃ.ən.əl/ (tính từ): quốc tế. "International" = quốc tế; trái nghĩa: domestic (trong nước).
items.explanationEn: international /ˌɪn.təˈnæʃ.ən.əl/ (adjective): between many countries. "International" involves many countries; the opposite is domestic.

items.question: Trong câu "After registering, you edit the DNS records at the Nameserver (usually with the registrar itself or a separate DNS service such as Cloudflare).", từ "edit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "After registering, you edit the DNS records at the Nameserver (usually with the registrar itself or a separate DNS service such as Cloudflare).", what does "edit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: edit /ˈed.ɪt/ (động từ): chỉnh sửa. "Edit the DNS records" = chỉnh sửa bản ghi DNS; danh từ: edit, editor.
items.explanationEn: edit /ˈed.ɪt/ (verb): to make changes to. "Edit the DNS records" means change them; nouns: edit, editor.

items.question: Trong câu "After registering, you edit the DNS records at the Nameserver (usually with the registrar itself or a separate DNS service such as Cloudflare).", từ "record" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "After registering, you edit the DNS records at the Nameserver (usually with the registrar itself or a separate DNS service such as Cloudflare).", what does "record" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: record /ˈrek.ɔːd/ (danh từ): bản ghi dữ liệu. "DNS records" = các bản ghi DNS; lưu ý danh từ nhấn âm đầu /ˈrek.ɔːd/, động từ nhấn âm sau /rɪˈkɔːd/.
items.explanationEn: record /ˈrek.ɔːd/ (noun): an entry of stored data. "DNS records" are stored entries; the noun stresses the first syllable, the verb the second.

items.question: Trong câu "After registering, you edit the DNS records at the Nameserver (usually with the registrar itself or a separate DNS service such as Cloudflare).", từ "usually" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "After registering, you edit the DNS records at the Nameserver (usually with the registrar itself or a separate DNS service such as Cloudflare).", what does "usually" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: usually /ˈjuː.ʒu.ə.li/ (trạng từ): thường thì. "Usually" = thường, trong đa số trường hợp; đồng nghĩa: typically, normally.
items.explanationEn: usually /ˈjuː.ʒu.ə.li/ (adverb): in most cases. "Usually" means in most cases; synonyms: typically, normally.

items.question: Trong câu "After registering, you edit the DNS records at the Nameserver (usually with the registrar itself or a separate DNS service such as Cloudflare).", từ "separate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "After registering, you edit the DNS records at the Nameserver (usually with the registrar itself or a separate DNS service such as Cloudflare).", what does "separate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: separate /ˈsep.ər.ət/ (tính từ): riêng biệt, tách rời. "A separate service" = một dịch vụ riêng; động từ "separate" phát âm /ˈsep.ər.eɪt/.
items.explanationEn: separate /ˈsep.ər.ət/ (adjective): apart and independent. "A separate service" is an independent one; the verb is pronounced /ˈsep.ər.eɪt/.

items.question: Trong câu "After registering, you edit the DNS records at the Nameserver (usually with the registrar itself or a separate DNS service such as Cloudflare).", từ "such as" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "After registering, you edit the DNS records at the Nameserver (usually with the registrar itself or a separate DNS service such as Cloudflare).", what does "such as" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: such as /ˈsʌtʃ əz/ (cụm từ): chẳng hạn như. "Such as + ví dụ" = chẳng hạn như; đồng nghĩa: like, for example.
items.explanationEn: such as /ˈsʌtʃ əz/ (phrase): for example. "Such as + examples" introduces examples; similar to like or for example.

items.question: Trong câu "Domain = an easy-to-remember name in place of an IP; it consists of subdomain + second-level + TLD.", từ "in place of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Domain = an easy-to-remember name in place of an IP; it consists of subdomain + second-level + TLD.", what does "in place of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in place of /ɪn ˈpleɪs əv/ (cụm từ): thay cho. "In place of X" = thay cho X; đồng nghĩa: instead of.
items.explanationEn: in place of /ɪn ˈpleɪs əv/ (phrase): instead of. "In place of X" means instead of X.

items.question: Trong câu "Domain = an easy-to-remember name in place of an IP; it consists of subdomain + second-level + TLD.", từ "consist of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Domain = an easy-to-remember name in place of an IP; it consists of subdomain + second-level + TLD.", what does "consist of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: consist of /kənˈsɪst əv/ (cụm từ): bao gồm, gồm có. "Consist of" = gồm có; không dùng dạng bị động ("is consisted of" là sai).
items.explanationEn: consist of /kənˈsɪst əv/ (phrase): to be made up of. "Consist of" means be made up of; it is never passive ("is consisted of" is wrong).

items.question: Trong câu "URI is the general concept; URL = a URI with a location; URN = a URI that is just a name.", từ "general" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "URI is the general concept; URL = a URI with a location; URN = a URI that is just a name.", what does "general" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: general /ˈdʒen.ər.əl/ (tính từ): chung, tổng quát. "General concept" = khái niệm tổng quát; danh từ "general" còn nghĩa là vị tướng.
items.explanationEn: general /ˈdʒen.ər.əl/ (adjective): broad, not specific. "General concept" is the broad idea; as a noun, a general is an army officer.

items.question: Trong câu "DNS resolves a domain → IP; the A record is the most important; TTL determines how fast DNS updates take effect.", từ "determine" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DNS resolves a domain → IP; the A record is the most important; TTL determines how fast DNS updates take effect.", what does "determine" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: determine /dɪˈtɜː.mɪn/ (động từ): quyết định, xác định. "X determines Y" = X quyết định Y; tính từ: determined (quyết tâm).
items.explanationEn: determine /dɪˈtɜː.mɪn/ (verb): to control or decide. "X determines Y" means X controls Y; the adjective determined means resolute.

items.question: Trong câu "DNS resolves a domain → IP; the A record is the most important; TTL determines how fast DNS updates take effect.", từ "update" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DNS resolves a domain → IP; the A record is the most important; TTL determines how fast DNS updates take effect.", what does "update" (noun) mean?
options: bản cập nhật, thay đổi mới
items.explanation: update /ˈʌp.deɪt/ (danh từ): bản cập nhật, thay đổi mới. "DNS updates" = các thay đổi DNS mới; danh từ nhấn âm đầu, động từ nhấn âm sau.
items.explanationEn: update /ˈʌp.deɪt/ (noun): a recent change. "DNS updates" are recent changes; the noun stresses the first syllable, the verb the second.
